issues: Title too short (14 chars, aim for 30-60)

ai_insights.executive_summary: The website has a critically low SEO score of 42/100 with multiple fundamental issues affecting search visibility and social sharing. Missing meta description, inadequate title tag, absent canonical URL, and incomplete Open Graph tags are severely limiting the site's ability to rank well and appear properly in search results and social media shares.

weak_points.title: Missing meta description
weak_points.why_it_matters: Meta descriptions directly impact click-through rates from search results and are often used as the snippet text, affecting organic traffic acquisition
weak_points.root_cause: No meta description tag implemented in the HTML head section
fix_steps: Add meta description tag in HTML head
Write compelling 150-160 character description that includes target keywords
Ensure description accurately summarizes page content

weak_points.title: Title tag too short and non-descriptive
weak_points.why_it_matters: Title tags are the most important on-page SEO factor and appear as clickable headlines in search results, directly affecting rankings and CTR
weak_points.root_cause: Generic 'Example Domain' title with only 14 characters provides no keyword value or user context
fix_steps: Make title descriptive and compelling for users
Follow format: Primary Keyword | Brand Name

weak_points.title: Missing canonical URL
weak_points.why_it_matters: Canonical tags prevent duplicate content issues and help search engines understand the preferred version of the page, avoiding ranking dilution
weak_points.root_cause: No canonical link tag specified in HTML head section
fix_steps: Add canonical link tag pointing to the preferred URL version
Ensure canonical URL is absolute and accessible

weak_points.title: Missing Open Graph tags for social sharing
weak_points.why_it_matters: Open Graph tags control how content appears when shared on social media platforms, affecting social traffic and brand presentation
weak_points.root_cause: No og:title, og:description, or og:image tags implemented
fix_steps: Add og:title tag with compelling title
Add og:image with high-quality branded image (1200x630px)
Include og:url and og:type tags for completeness

quick_wins: Add meta description tag with 150-160 character compelling summary
Expand title tag to 30-60 characters with target keywords
Implement canonical URL tag pointing to preferred page version
Add basic Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image)
